script.title: PASSING THE MOVE-OUT INSPECTION
script.story_hook: Walking through the empty apartment for the final move-out check.
script.intro_zh: 在搬空的公寓裡做最後的退租點交。
script.welcome_en: Hi again, everyone! Today we're facing the move-out check.
script.welcome_zh: 各位又見面了！今天我們要面對退租點交。
script.outro: Clean room, full deposit, happy ending. Listen again soon!
script.outro_zh: 乾淨的房間、完整的押金、圓滿的結局。敬請再次收聽！
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: read each line with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你跟著我，一句一句朗讀。

script.youtube_title_en: “I Scrubbed Like Crazy” — Passing the Move-Out Inspection
script.youtube_description:

script.youtube_description_en:
Want your full deposit back at move-out? This 18-line walkthrough inspection teaches you to check the flat with the manager, negotiate a carpet stain, use check-in notes to prove old scuffs, and even offer touch-up paint. Natural American English with IPA and translation, then repeat every line out loud in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🏠退租點交英文｜房間檢查・污漬扣款・入住記錄比對｜聽完就會點交｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
搬出去那天，管理員拿著清單走來走去說啥？
押金到底會扣走多少？其實可以用英文談！

這一集帶大家走進一間剛搬空的出租公寓，跟著房客與管理員從逐間檢查房間、討論地毯污漬的扣款、比對入住記錄裡的舊刮痕，到主動補漆換回全額押金，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🧹 檢查房間：例如「any problems?」、「looks pretty clean overall」。
💰 談扣款：例如「maybe ten dollars for the carpet guy」、「could I clean it again before you decide?」。
📋 比對記錄：例如「the check-in notes say exactly that」、「you get your full deposit」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

搬家的最後一哩路，用英文保住你的押金！
script.thumbnail_action: handing over a set of keys with a thumbs up

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are! Empty since yesterday. Any problems?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr wi ɑr ˈɛmpti sɪns jɛstərdeɪ ˈɛni ˈprɑbləmz/
dialogue.zh: 就是這裡！昨天已經完全搬空。有什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks pretty clean overall, honestly. Nice job.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊks ˈprɪti klin ˌoʊvərˈɔl ˈɑnəstli naɪs dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 老實說整體看起來很乾淨。做得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yay! I scrubbed like crazy all weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /je aɪ skrʌbd laɪk ˈkreɪzi ɔl ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 耶！我整個週末拼命刷洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, what's this stain right here by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wʌts ðɪs steɪn raɪt hɪr baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，窗邊這一塊痕跡是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that coffee spill. I tried everything on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæt ˈkɔfi spɪl aɪ traɪd ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那個咖啡灑的。我用盡了所有辦法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's faint. Maybe ten dollars for the carpet guy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts.feɪnt meɪbi tɛn ˈdɑlərz fɔr ðə ˈkɑrpɪt ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很淡了。地毯清潔可能會扣十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Could I clean it again before you decide?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr kʊd aɪ klin ɪt əˈɡɛn bɪˈfɔr ju dɪˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 合理。在你決定前，我可以再清一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but I also see some scuff marks here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr bət aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ si sʌm skʌf mɑrks hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過我在這裡還看到一些刮擦痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those were there when I moved in, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz wɜr ðɛr wɛn aɪ mud ɪn aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那些在我搬進來的時候就有了，我記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're right, the check-in notes say exactly that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr raɪt ðə tʃɛk.ɪn noʊts se ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，進住記錄上寫的正是這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew! So it's just the carpet, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /fu soʊ ɪts dʒʌst ðə ˈkɑrpɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 呼！所以只剩地毯的問題了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the hallway wall needs a small paint touch-up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ wɔl nidz ə smɔl peɪnt ˈtʌtʃ.ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 還有走廊那面牆要小範圍補一下漆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I actually bought matching paint already. Want me to?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈæktʃuəli bɑt ˈmætʃɪŋ peɪnt ɔlˈrɛdi wɑnt mi tə/
dialogue.zh: 我其實已經買了同色的油漆。要我來補嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would help a lot. Can you do it today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʊd hɛlp ə lɑt kæn ju du ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那會幫了大忙。你今天能弄好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me two hours, then come back and check.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡiv mi tu ˈaʊərz ðɛn kʌm bæk ænd tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 給我兩小時，然後你再回來檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay! If it looks good, that's your full deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪf ɪt lʊks ɡʊd ðæts jʊr fʊl dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好！如果補得乾淨，押金就全額退給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal! Thanks for being so fair about this.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil θæŋks fər ˈbiɪŋ soʊ fɛr əˈbaʊt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 說定！謝謝你處理得這麼公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Smooth move-outs make everyone happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs smuθ ˈmaʊv.aʊts meɪk ˈɛvriwʌn ˈhæpi/
dialogue.zh: 應該的。順利的退租點交，大家都開心。
